sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up broadly grinning officer in three-quarter screen-left pose, with clearly exposed white teeth and deep smiling cheek/eye lines. Very short brown hair at the temples, brown eyebrows, no moustache or beard: keep bare smooth upper lip/chin beneath the actual toothy grin. Gray-olive soft field cap with a short visor, gold edge piping and two small front gold buttons; preserve the original peaked fold instead of inventing a large peaked officer cap. Gray-olive closed tunic with rectangular gold/yellow collar tabs containing parallel red horizontal bars, fine pale blue-white inner collar edge, central gold throat button and gold shoulder decorations. Keep the complete light gray painted rectangular backing, crop and original light. Source alpha249..255 is recorded; fit the tunic to a short broad mascot neck and retain the open smiling expression.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Almost front-facing chest-up middle-aged officer with a high receding hairline, very short close brown-gray side hair and a small darker side-parted wave across the crown. Strong visible brows, firm closed mouth and smooth bare upper lip/jaw/chin with no moustache or beard; no hat or spectacles. Dark olive high-collared uniform with red collar patches bearing gold leaf-shaped embroidery, central gold throat button, pale blue inner collar line and gold braided shoulder ornaments on red bases. Preserve exact hairstyle silhouette rather than making the head entirely bald, serious pose, light, crop and full pale gray painted rectangular backing. Source alpha249..255 is recorded; short broad yellow mascot neck fitted into the closed tunic.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up older moustached officer facing slightly toward screen-left with a grave closed mouth and thick gray eyebrows. Neat short gray-brown side hair under an olive side/garrison cap angled across the forehead, bearing one small oval gold-and-pale badge near the top screen-right. Conspicuous wide bushy silver-gray upper-lip moustache only, its ends extending down slightly; keep cheeks/jaw/chin bare with no beard. Plain olive high-collared tunic closed at the throat, central gold button and small gold-buttoned shoulder straps, no tie or medals. Preserve the exact cap tilt, moustache shape, framing, lighting and complete pale gray painted backing; source alpha249..255 is recorded. Use compact broad mascot head and short neck naturally seated in the collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up older officer looking upward and toward screen-left with a solemn closed mouth, short gray side hair under the cap and thick dark-gray eyebrows. Upper lip/jaw/chin are bare with no moustache or beard. Olive peaked cap with fine gold piping, dark band and visor, gold embroidered visor edge and central gold crossed-shapes/crown-like badge; keep tiny emblem details as visible shapes. Olive service coat with red collar tabs carrying gold vertical decoration, small gold buttoned shoulder straps, muted gray-khaki shirt and dark olive tie, with a brown leather strap visible from screen-left shoulder. Preserve pose, shoulders, upper-left lighting and full pale gray painted rectangular backing. Source alpha249..255 is recorded; fit the original collar and tie around a short broad mascot neck.
